$comment: What to bake. source is relative to the repo root; output goes to frontend/public/models/<id>/. clips: name -> source clip in the glb, or a procedural generator from clips.mjs ("@swing", "@bow", "@die", grab3d rig only). footBone: bone that measures the stride (default footL). reverse: play the source clip backwards (unbrace = brace reversed). albedo: optional, default textures/<skin>_albedo.png next to the source.
